text.am: ነገር ግን ከዚያ በኋላ የአሞንን ልጆች ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.

text.am: ስለ ኤዶምያስ፤ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በውኑ በቴማን ጥበብ የለምን? ከብልሃተኞችስ ምክር ጠፍቶአልን?
text.en: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

text.am: ጥበባቸውስ አልቆአልን? እናንተ በድዳን የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የዔሳውን ጥፋት፥ የምጐበኝበትን ጊዜ፥ አመጣበታለሁና ሽሹ፥ ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ፥ በጥልቅም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ።
text.en: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.

text.am: ወይን ለቃሚዎች ቢመጡብህ፥ ቃርሚያውን አይተውልህምን? ሌቦችስ በሌሊት ቢመጡ፥ የሚያጠፉት እስኪበቃቸው ድረስ አይደለምን?
text.en: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

text.am: እኔ ግን ዔሳውን ዐራቈትሁት፥ የተሸሸጉትንም ስፍራዎች ገለጥሁ፥ ይሸሸግም ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ዘሩም ወንድሞቹም ጎረቤቶቹም ጠፍተዋል እርሱም የለም።
text.en: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.

text.am: ድሀ አደጎችህን ተው፥ እኔም በሕይወት አኖራቸዋለሁ፤ መበለቶችህም በእኔ ይታመኑ።
text.en: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ጽዋውን ያልተገባቸው ሰዎች ጠጥተውታል፤ አንተም ሳትቀጣ ትቀራለህን? በእርግጥ ትጠጣለህ እንጂ ያለ ቅጣት አትቀርም።
text.en: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.

text.am: ባሶራ መደነቂያና መሰደቢያ መረገሚያም እንድትሆን በራሴ ምያለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ከተሞችዋም ሁሉ ለዘላለም ባድማ ይሆናሉ።
text.en: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

text.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወሬ ሰምቻለሁ በአሕዛብም መካከል። ተሰብሰቡ፥ በእርስዋም ላይ ኑ ለሰልፍም ተነሡ የሚል መልእክተኛ ተልኮአል።
text.en: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

text.am: እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ የተጠቃህ፥ በሰዎችም ዘንድ የተናቅህ አድርጌሃለሁ።
text.en: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.

text.am: በዓለት ንቃቃት ውስጥ የምትቀመጥ፥ የተራራውን ከፍታ የምትይዝ ሆይ፥ ድፍረትህና የልብህ ኵራት አታልለውሃል። ቤትህን ምንም እንደ ንስር ከፍ ብታደርግ፥ ከዚያ አወርድሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.

text.am: ኤዶምያስም መደነቂያ ትሆናለች፥ የሚያልፍባትም ሁሉ ይደነቃል፥ ስለ መጣባትም መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ያፍዋጭባታል።
text.en: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

text.am: ሰዶምና ገሞራ በእነርሱም አጠገብ የነበሩት ከተሞች እንደ ተገለበጡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዲሁ በዚያ ሰው አይቀመጥም የሰው ልጅም አይኖርባትም።
text.en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቶሎ አባርራቸዋለሁና በጠነከረው አምባ ላይ ከዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ውስጥ እንደ አንበሳ ይወጣል፤ የተመረጠውንም በእርስዋ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ፤ እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ወይስ ለእኔ ጊዜ የሚወስን ማን ነው? ወይስ ፊቴን የሚቃወም እረኛ ማን ነው?
text.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

text.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በኤዶምያስ ላይ የመከረባትን ምክር፥ በቴማንም በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ላይ ያሰባትን አሳብ ስሙ፤ በእውነት የመንጋ ትንንሾች ይጐተታሉ፤ በእውነት ማደሪያቸውን ባድማ ያደርግባቸዋል።
text.en: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

text.am: ከመውደቃቸው ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች፥ የጩኸታቸውም ድምፅ በኤርትራ ባሕር ተሰማ።
text.en: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.

text.am: እነሆ፥ እንደ ንስር ወጥቶ ይበራል ክንፉንም በባሶራ ላይ ይዘረጋል፥ በዚያም ቀን የኤዶምያስ ኃያላን ልብ ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ልብ ይሆናል።
text.en: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

text.am: ስለ ደማስቆ፤ ክፉ ወሬ ሰምተዋልና ሐማትና አርፋድ አፈሩ ቀለጡም፤ በባሕርም ላይ ኅዘን አለ፥ ታርፍም ዘንድ አትችልም።
text.en: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

text.am: ደማስቆ ደከመች ትሸሽም ዘንድ ዘወር አለች እንቅጥቅጥም ያዛት፥ እንደ ወላድም ሴት ጣርና ምጥ ያዛት።
text.en: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

text.am: የተመሰገነችው ከተማ፥ የደስታዬ ከተማ፥ ሳትለቀቅ እንዴት ቀረች?
text.en: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

text.am: ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝትዋ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞች ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.

text.am: በደማስቆም ቅጥር ላይ እሳት አነድዳለሁ የወልደ አዴርንም አዳራሾች ትበላለች።
text.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.

text.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ስለ መታ ስለ ቄዳርና ስለ አሶር መንግሥታት፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ተነሡ ወደ ቄዳርም ውጡ፥ የምሥራቅንም ልጆች አጥፉ።
text.en: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

text.am: ድንኳናቸውንና መንጋቸውን ይወስዳሉ፤ መጋረጆቻቸውንና ዕቃቸውን ሁሉ ግመሎቻቸውንም ለራሳቸው ይወስዳሉ፥ በዙሪያቸውም ሁሉ ጥፋትን ጥሩባቸው።
text.en: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.

text.am: እናንተ በአሶር የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ተማክሮባችኋልና፥ አሳብም አስቦባችኋልና ሽሹ ወደ ሩቅም ሂዱ በጥልቅም ውስጥ ተቀመጡ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

text.am: ተነሡ፥ ዕርፊት ወዳለበት ተዘልሎም ወደ ተቀመጠው፥ ደጅና መወርወሪያ ወደሌለው ብቻውንም ወደ ተቀመጠው ሕዝብ ውጡ።
text.en: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.

text.am: ግመሎቻቸው ይበዘበዛሉ የእንስሶቻቸውም ብዛት ይማረካል፤ ጠgWraቸውንም በዙሪያ የሚላጩትን ሰዎች ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ ከዳርቻቸውም ሁሉ ጥፋት አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.

text.am: አሶርም የቀበሮ መኖሪያና የዘላለም ባድማ ትሆናለች፤ በዚያም ሰው አይኖርም፥ የሰው ልጅም አይቀመጥባትም።
text.en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.

text.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሴዴቅያስ መንግሥት መጀመሪያ ስለ ኤላም ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኤርምያስ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።
text.en: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

text.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ዋና የኃይላቸው መሣሪያ የሆነውን የኤላምን ቀስት እሰብራለሁ።
text.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

text.am: ከአራቱም ከሰማይ ማዕዘናት አራቱን ነፋሳት በኤላም ላይ አመጣለሁ፥ ወደ እነዚያም ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናቸዋለሁ፤ ከኤላም የተሰደዱ ሰዎች የማይደርሱበት ሕዝብ አይገኝም።
text.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

text.am: በጠላቶቻቸውና ነፍሳቸውን በሚሹአት ፊት ኤላምን አስደነግጣለሁ፤ ክፉ ነገርን እርሱም ጽኑ ቍጣዬን አመጣባቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ በኋላቸው ሰይፍ እሰድድባቸዋለሁ፤
text.en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

text.am: ዙፋኔንም በኤላም አኖራለሁ ከዚያም ንጉሡንና አለቆቹን አጠፋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.

text.am: ነገር ግን በኋለኛው ዘመን የኤላምን ምርኮ እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ከለዳውያን ምድር ስለ ባቢሎን በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ የተናገረው ቃል ይህ ነው።
text.en: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

text.am: በአሕዛብ መካከል ተናገሩ አውሩም፥ ዓላማውንም አንሡ፤ አውሩ፥ አትደብቁ። ባቢሎን ተወሰደች፥ ቤል አፈረ፥ ሜሮዳክ ደነገጠ፤ ምስሎችዋ አፈሩ፥ ጣዖታትዋ ደነገጡ በሉ።
text.en: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

text.am: ሕዝብ ከሰሜን ወጥቶባታል ምድርዋንም ባድማ ያደርጋል፥ የሚቀመጥባትም አይገኝም፤ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ሸሽተው ሄደዋል።
text.en: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

text.am: በዚያም ወራት በዚያም ጊዜ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች በአንድነት ሆነው ይመጣሉ፥ እያለቀሱም መንገዳቸውን ይሄዳሉ፥ አምላካቸውንም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጋሉ።
text.en: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.

text.am: ፊታቸውንም ወደዚያ አቅንተው። ኑ፥ ከቶ በማይረሳ በዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተጠጉ ብለው ስለ ጽዮን መንገድ ይጠይቃሉ።
text.en: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.

text.am: ሕዝቤ የጠፉ በጎች ሆነዋል፤ እረኞቻቸው አሳቱአቸው፥ በተራሮችም ላይ የተቅበዘበዙ አደረጉአቸው፤ ከተራራ ወደ ኮረብታ አለፉ፥ በረታቸውንም ረሱ።
text.en: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

text.am: ያገኙአቸው ሁሉ በሉአቸው፥ ጠላቶቻቸውም። በጽድቅ ማደሪያ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ፥ በአባቶቻቸው ተስፋ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ስለ ሠሩ እኛ አልበደልንም አሉ።
text.en: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.

text.am: ከባቢሎን መካከል ሽሹ፥ ከከለዳውያንም ድር ውጡ፥ በመንጎችም ፊት እንደ አውራ ፍየሎች ሁኑ።
text.en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ከሰሜን ምድር የታላላቅ አሕዛብን ጉባኤ አስነሣለሁ በባቢሎንም ላይ አመጣቸዋለሁ፤ በእርስዋም ላይ ይሰለፋሉ፥ ከዚያም ትወሰዳለች፤ ፍላጾቻቸውም ባዶውን እንደማይመለስ እንደ ብልህ ጀግና ፍላጻ ናቸው።
text.en: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.

text.am: የከላውዴዎንም ምድር ትበዘበዛለች፥ የሚበዘብዙአትም ሁሉ ይጠግባሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.

text.am: ርስቴን የምትበዘብዙ እናንተ ሆይ፥ ደስ ብሎአችኋልና፥ ሐሤትንም አድርጋችኋልና፥ በመስክ ላይም እንዳለች ጊደር ሆናችሁ ተቀናጥታችኋልና፥ እንደ ብርቱዎችም ፈረሶች አሽካክታችኋልና፥
text.en: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;

text.am: እናታችሁ እጅግ ታፍራለች፥ የወለደቻችሁም ትጐሰቍላለች፤ እነሆ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል ኋለኛይቱ ትሆናለች፤ ምድረ በዳና ደረቅ ምድር በረሀም ትሆናለች።
text.en: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

text.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ የተነሣ ባድማ ትሆናለች እንጂ ሰው አይቀመጥባትም፤ በባቢሎንም በኩል የሚያልፍ ሁሉ ይደነቃል በመጣባትም መቅሠፍት ሁሉ ያፍዋጫል።
text.en: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

text.am: እናንተ ቀስትን የምትገትሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በባቢሎን ላይ በዙሪያዋ ተሰለፉ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኃጢአት ሠርታለችና ወርውሩባት ፍላጾችንም አትንፈጉ።
text.en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔር በቀል ነውና በዙሪያዋ ጩኹባት፤ እጅዋን ሰጠች፤ ግንቦችዋ ወደቁ ቅጥሮችዋም ፈረሱ፤ እርስዋን ተበቀሉ እንደ ሠራችውም ሥሩባት።
text.en: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

text.am: ዘሪውንና በመከር ጊዜ ማጭድ የሚይዘውን ከባቢሎን አጥፉ፤ ከሚያስጨንቅ ሰይፍ ፊት እያንዳንዱ ወደ ወገኑ ይመለሳል እያንዳንዱም ወደ አገሩ ይሸሻል።
text.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

text.am: እስራኤል የባዘነ በግ ነው፤ አንበሶች አሳደዱት፤ መጀመሪያ የአሦር ንጉሥ በላው፥ በመጨረሻም የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር አጥንቱን ቈረጠመው።
text.en: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

text.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የአሦርን ንጉሥ እንደ ቀጣሁ እንዲሁ፥ እነሆ፥ የባቢሎንን ንጉሥና ምድሩን እቀጣለሁ።
text.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

text.am: እስራኤልንም ወደ ማሰማርያው እመልሳለሁ፥ በቀርሜሎስና በባሳንም ላይ ይሰማራል፥ ሰውነቱም በኤፍሬም ተራራና በገለዓድ ላይ ትጠግባለች።
text.en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

text.am: እነዚህን ያስቀረኋቸውን ይቅር እላቸዋለሁና በዚያን ወራት በዚያም ዘመን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ የእስራኤል በደል የይሁዳም ኃጢአት ይፈለጋል ምንም አይገኝም።
text.en: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

text.am: በምራታይም ምድር ላይ በፋቁድም በሚኖሩት ላይ ውጣ፤ ግደላቸው ፈጽመህም አጥፋቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዳዘዝሁህም ሁሉ አድርግ።
text.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

text.am: የሰልፍና የታላቅ ጥፋት ውካታ በምድር ላይ አለ።
text.en: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

text.am: የምድር ሁሉ መዶሻ እንዴት ደቀቀ እንዴትስ ተሰበረ! ባቢሎንስ በአሕዛብ መካከል እንዴት ባድማ ሆነች!
text.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

text.am: ባቢሎን ሆይ፥ አጥምጄብሻለሁ አንቺም ሳታውቂ ተይዘሻል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስለ ተዋጋሽ ተገኝተሻል ተይዘሽማል።
text.en: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.

text.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር በከለዳውያን ምድር ይሠራ ዘንድ ሥራ አለውና እግዚአብሔር ዕቃ ቤቱን ከፍቶ የቍጣውን ዕቃ ጦር አውጥቶአል።
text.en: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

text.am: ከየበኩሉ በእርስዋ ላይ ውጡ፥ ጎተራዎችዋንም ክፈቱ፤ እንደ ክምርም አድርጓት ፈጽማችሁም አጥፉአት፥ አንዳችም አታስቀሩላት።
text.en: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

text.am: ወይፈኖችዋን ሁሉ እረዱ፥ ወደ መታረድም ይውረዱ፤ ቀናቸው፥ የመጐብኘታቸው ጊዜ፥ ደርሶአልና ወዮላቸው!
text.en: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

text.am: የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን በቀል የመቅደሱንም በቀል በጽዮን ይነግሩ ዘንድ ሸሽተው ከባቢሎን አገር ያመለጡት ሰዎች ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።
text.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.

text.am: ቀስትን የሚገትሩትን ቀስተኞችን ሁሉ በባቢሎን ላይ ጥሩአቸው፤ በዙሪያዋ ስፈሩባት አንድም አያምልጥ፤ በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ኰርታለችና እንደ ሥራዋ መጠን መልሱላት፥ እንዳደረገችም ሁሉ አድርጉባት።
text.en: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.

text.am: ስለዚህ ጐበዛዝትዋ በአደባባይዋ ላይ ይወድቃሉ፥ በዚያም ቀን ሰልፈኞችዋ ሁሉ ይጠፋሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.

text.am: ትዕቢተኛው ሆይ፥ የመጐብኘትህ ጊዜ፥ ቀንህ ደርሶአልና እነሆ፥ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.

text.am: ትዕቢተኛው ተሰናክሎ ይወድቃል የሚያነሣውም የለም፤ በከተሞቹም ውስጥ እሳት አነድዳለሁ፥ በዙሪያውም ያለውን ሁሉ ትበላለች።
text.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.

text.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእስራኤል ልጆችና የይሁዳ ልጆች በአንድነት ተገፍተዋል፥ የማረኳቸውም ሁሉ በኃይል ይይዙአቸዋል፥ ይለቅቁአቸውም ዘንድ እንቢ ብለዋል።
text.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

text.am: ተቤዢአቸው ብርቱ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ምድርንም ያሳርፍ ዘንድ በባቢሎንም የሚኖሩትን ያውክ ዘንድ ሙግታቸውን ፈጽም ይምዋገታል።
text.en: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

text.am: ሰይፍ በከለዳውያንና በባቢሎን በሚኖሩ ላይ፥ በአለቆችዋና በጥበበኞችዋ ላይ አለ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.

text.am: ሰይፍ በሚጓደዱት ላይ አለ ሰነፎችም ይሆናሉ፥ ሰይፍም በኃያላኖችዋ ላይ አለ እነርሱም ይደነግጣሉ።
text.en: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

text.am: ሰይፍ በፈረሶቻቸውና በሰረገሎቻቸው ላይ በመካከልዋም ባሉት በልዩ በልዩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ላይ አለ፥ እነርሱም እንደ ሴቶች ይሆናሉ፤ ሰይፍም በመዝገብዋ ላይ አለ ለብዝበዛም ይሆናል።
text.en: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.

text.am: እርስዋ የተቀረጹ ምስሎች ምድር ናት፥ እነርሱም በጣዖታት ይመካሉና ድርቅ በውኆችዋ ላይ ይሆናል እነርሱም ይደርቃሉ።
text.en: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.

text.am: ስለዚህ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ከተኵላዎች ጋር ይቀመጡባታል፥ ሰጐኖችም ይቀመጡባታል፤ ሰውም ከዚያ ወዲያ ለዘላለም አይቀመጥባትም፥ እስከ ልጅ ልጅም ድረስ የሚኖርባት የለም።
text.en: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

text.am: ሰዶምንና ገሞራን በአጠገባቸውም የነበሩትን ከተምች እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጣቸው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ እንዲሁ ሰው በዚያ አይቀመጥም የሰውም ልጅ አይኖርባትም።
text.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ሕዝብ ከሰሜን ይመጣል ታላቅ ሕዝብና ብዙ ነገሥታትም ከምድር ዳርቻ ይነሣሉ።
text.en: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

text.am: ቀስትንና ጦርን ይይዛሉ፤ ጨካኞች ናቸው ምሕረትም አያደርጉም፤ ድምፃቸው እንደ ባሕር ይተምማል በፈረሶችም ላይ ይቀመጣሉ፤ የባቢሎን ሴት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ሰው እያንዳንዳቸው በአንቺ ላይ ተሰለፉ።
text.en: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

text.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወሬአቸውን ሰምቶአል፥ እጁም ደክማለች፥ ጭንቀትም ይዞታል፥ ምጥ ወላድ ሴትን እንደሚይዛት ጭንቀት ይዞታል።
text.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ በቶሎ አባርራቸዋለሁና በጠነከረው አምባ ላይ ከዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ውስጥ እንደ አንበሳ ይወጣል፤ የተመረጠውንም በእርስዋ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ፤ እንደ እኔ ያለ ማን ነው? ወይስ ለእኔ ጊዜ የሚወስን ማን ነው? ወይስ ፊቴን የሚቃወም እረኛ ማን ነው?
text.en: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

text.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን ላይ የመከረባትን ምክር፥ በከለዳውያንም ምድር ላይ ያሰባትን አሳብ ስሙ፤ በእውነት የመንጋ ትናንሾች ይጎተታሉ፤ በእውነት ማደሪያቸውን ባድማ ያደርግባቸዋል።
text.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.

text.am: ከባቢሎን መያዝ ድምፅ የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች፥ ጩኸትም በአሕዛብ መካከል ዘንድ ተሰማ።
text.en: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በባቢሎን ላይና በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ አጥፊውን ነፋስ አስነሣለሁ።
text.en: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;

text.am: በባቢሎንም ላይ የሚያዘሩትን ሰዎች እሰድዳለሁ እነርሱም ያዘሩአታል፥ ምድርዋንም ባዶ ያደርጋሉ፤ በመከራም ቀን በዙሪያዋ ይከብቡአታል።
text.en: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

text.am: በወርዋሪው ላይ በጥሩርም በሚነሣው ላይ ቀስተኛው ቀስቱን ይገትር፤ ለጐበዛዝትዋ አትዘኑ ሠራዊትዋንም ሁሉ አጥፉ።
text.en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

text.am: በከለዳውያንም ምድር ተገድለው፥ በሜዳዋም ላይ ተወግተው ይወድቃሉ።
text.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.

text.am: ምድራቸው በእስራኤል ቅዱስ ላይ በተሠራው በደል ምንም እንኳ የተሞላች ብትሆን፥ እስራኤልም ሆነ ይሁዳ በአምላኩ በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አልተጣለም።
text.en: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

text.am: ከባቢሎን ውስጥ ሽሹ፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ነፍሳችሁን አድኑ፤ በበደልዋ አትጥፉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር በቀል ጊዜ ነውና፥ እርሱም ብድራትዋን ይከፍላታልና።
text.en: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD'S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.

text.am: ባቢሎን በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ውስጥ ምድርን ሁሉ ያሰከረች የወርቅ ጽዋ ነበረች፥ አሕዛብም ከጠጅዋ ጠጥተዋል፤ ስለዚህ አሕዛብ አብደዋል።
text.en: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD'S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

text.am: ባቢሎን በድንገት ወድቃ ጠፍታለች፤ አልቅሱላት፥ ትፈወስም እንደ ሆነ ለKWsልዋ መድኃኒት ውሰዱላት።
text.en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

text.am: ባቢሎንን ፈወስናት፥ እርስዋ ግን አልተፈወሰችም፤ ፍርድዋ እስከ ሰማይ ደርሶአልና፥ እስከ ደመናም ድረስ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና ትታችኋት እያንዳንዳችን ወደ አገራችን እንሂድ።
text.en: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽድቃችንን አውጥቶአል፤ ኑ፥ በጽዮን የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ እንናገር።
text.en: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

text.am: ፍላጾችን ሳሉ ጋሻዎችንም አዘጋጁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ያጠፋት ዘንድ አሳቡ በባቢሎን ላይ ነውና የሜዶንን ነገሥታት መንፈስ አስነሥቶአል፤ የእግዚብሔር በቀል የመቅደሱ በቀል ነውና።
text.en: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.

text.am: በባቢሎን ቅጥር ዓላማውን አንሡበት፥ ጥበቃን አጽኑ፥ ተመልካቾችን አቁሙ፥ ድብቅ ጦር አዘጋጁ። እግዚአብሔር በባቢሎን በሚኖሩት ላይ የተናገረውን አስቦአልና፥ አድርጎአልምና።
text.en: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.

text.am: አንቺ በብዙ ውኃ አጠገብ የተቀመጥሽ፥ በመዝገብም የበለጠግሽ ሆይ፥ እንደ ስስትሽ መጠን ፍጻሜሽ ደርሶአል።
text.en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.

text.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ሲል በራሱ ምሎአል። በእውነት ሰዎችን እንደ አንበጣ እሞላብሻለሁ፥ እነርሱም ጩኸት ያነሡብሻል።
text.en: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.

text.am: ምድርን በኃይሉ የፈጠረ፥ ዓለሙን በጥበቡ የመሠረተ፥ ሰማያትንም በማስተዋሉ የዘረጋ እርሱ ነው።
text.en: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

text.am: ድምጹን ባሰማ ጊዜ ውኆች በሰማይ ይታወካሉ፥ ከምድርም ዳር ደመናትን ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ ለዝናብም መብረቅን ያደርጋል፥ ነፍስንም ከቤተ መዛግብቱ ያወጣል።
text.en: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

text.am: ሰው ሁሉ እውቀት አጥቶ ሰንፎአል፥ አንጥረኛም ሁሉ ከቀረጸው ምስል የተነሣ አፍሮአል፤ ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስሉ ውሸት ነውና፥ እስትንፋስም የላቸውምና።
text.en: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

text.am: እነርሱም ምናምንቴና የቀልድ ሥራ ናቸው፤ በተጐበኙ ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።
text.en: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

text.am: የያዕቆብ እድል ፈንታ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፥ እርሱ የሁሉ ፈጣሪ ነውና፤ እስራኤልም የርስቱ ነገድ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።
text.en: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.

text.am: አንቺ መዶሻዬና የጦር መሣሪያዬ ነሽ፤ በአንቺ አሕዛብን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም መንግሥታትን አጠፋለሁ፤
text.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;

text.am: በአንቺ ፈረሱንና ፈረሰኛውን እሰባብራለሁ፤
text.en: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;

text.am: በአንቺም ሰረገላውንና በላዩ የሚቀመጠውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ወንድንና ሴትን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ሽማግሌውንና ብላቴናውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም ጐልማሳውንና ቆንጆይቱን እሰባብራለሁ፤
text.en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

text.am: በአንቺም እረኛውንና መንጋውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም አራሹንና ጥማጁን እሰባብራለሁ፤ በአንቺም አለቆችንና ሹማምቶችን አሰባብራለሁ።
text.en: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

text.am: በጽዮን በዓይናችሁ ፊት ስለሠሩት ክፋታቸው ሁሉ በባቢሎንና በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩ ሁሉ ላይ ፍዳቸውን እከፍላለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.

text.am: አንተ ምድርን ሁሉ የምታጠፋ አጥፊ ተራራ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ እጄንም እዘረጋብሃለሁ፥ ከድንጋዮችም ላይ አንከባልልሃለሁ፥ የተቃጠለም ተራራ አደርግሃለሁ።
text.en: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.

text.am: ከአንተም ለማዕዘንና ለመሠረት የሚሆን ድንጋይ አይወስዱም፥ ለዘላለምም ባድማ ትሆናለህ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.

text.am: በምድር ላይ ዓላማን አንሡ በአሕዛብም መካከል መለከት ንፉ፥ አሕዛብንም አዘጋጁባት፤ የአራራትንና የሚኒን የአስከናዝንም መንግሥታት ሰብስቡባት አለቃንም በላይዋ አቁሙ፤ እንደ ጠgWraም ኩብኩባ ፈረሶችን በላይዋ አውጡ።
text.en: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

text.am: አሕዛብን የሚዶንንም ነገሥታት አለቆችንም ሹማምቶችንም ሁሉ የግዛታቸውንም ምድር ሁሉ አዘጋጁባት።
text.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.

text.am: ማንም እንዳይቀመጥባት የባቢሎንን ምድር ባድማ ያደርጋት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር አሳብ በባቢሎን ላይ ጸንቶአልና ምድር ተናወጣለች ታመመችም።
text.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.

text.am: የባቢሎን ኃያላን መዋጋትን ትተዋል በአምባዎቻቸውም ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል፤ ኃይላቸውም ጠፍቶአል እንደ ሴቶችም ሆነዋል፤ ማደሪያዎችዋም ነድደዋል መወርወሪያዎችዋም ተሰብረዋል።
text.en: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.

text.am: ከዳር እስከ ዳር ድረስ ከተማው እንደ ተያዘች መልካምዎችዋም እንደ ተያዙ፥ ቅጥርዋም በእሳት እንደ ተቃጠለ፥ ሰልፈኞችም እንደ ደነገጡ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ይነግር ዘንድ ወሬኛው ወሬኛውን መልእክተኛውም መልእክተኛውን ሊገናኝ ይሮጣል።
text.en: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,

text.am: ከዳር እስከ ዳር ድረስ ከተማው እንደ ተያዘች መልካምዎችዋም እንደ ተያዙ፥ ቅጥርዋም በእሳት እንደ ተቃጠለ፥ ሰልፈኞችም እንደ ደነገጡ ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ ይነግር ዘንድ ወሬኛው ወሬኛውን መልእክተኛውም መልእክተኛውን ሊገናኝ ይሮጣል።
text.en: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

text.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። አውድማ እንደ ተረገጠ ጊዜ፥ እንዲሁ የባቢሎን ልጅ ናት፤ ጥቂት ቈይታ የመከር ጊዜ ይደርስባታል።
text.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

text.am: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በላኝ፥ ከፋፈለኝም፥ እንደ ባዶ ዕቃም አደረገኝ፥ እንደ ዘንዶም ዋጠኝ፥ ከሚጣፍጠውም ምግቤ ሆዱን ሞላ፥ እኔንም ጣለኝ።
text.en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

text.am: በጽዮን የምትቀመጥ። በእኔና በሥጋዬ የተደረገ ግፍ በባቢሎን ላይ ይሁን ትላለች፤ ኢየሩሳሌምም። ደሜ በከለዳውያን ምድር በሚኖሩት ላይ ይሁን ትላለች።
text.en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

text.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እምዋገትልሻለሁ በቀልሽንም እበቀልልሻለሁ፤ ባሕርዋንም ድርቅ አደርገዋለሁ ምንጭዋንም አደርቀዋለሁ።
text.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.

text.am: ባቢሎንም የድንጋይ KWlልና የቀበሮ ማደሪያ መደነቂያም ማፍዋጫም ትሆናለች፥ የሚቀመጥባትም ሰው አይገኝም።
text.en: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.

text.am: በአንድነትም እንደ አንበሶች ያገሣሉ፥ እንደ አንበሳም ደቦሎች ያጕረመርማሉ።
text.en: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.

text.am: በሞቃቸው ጊዜ ደስ እንዲላቸው ለዘላለምም አንቀላፍተው እንዳይነቁ የመጠጥ ግብዣ አደርግላቸዋለሁ አሰክራቸውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.

text.am: እንደ ጠቦቶችና እንደ አውራ በጎች እንደ አውራ ፍየሎችም ወደ መታረድ አወርዳቸዋለሁ።
text.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.

text.am: ሼሻክ እንዴት ተያዘች! የምድርም ሁሉ ምስጋና እንዴት ተወሰደች! ባቢሎንም በአሕዛብ መካከል መደነቂያ እንዴት ሆነች!
text.en: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!

text.am: ባሕር በባቢሎን ላይ ወጣ በሞገዱም ብዛት ተከደነች።
text.en: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.

text.am: ከተሞችዋ ባድማና ደረቅ ምድር ምድረ በዳም፥ ሰውም የማይቀመጥበት የሰውም ልጅ የማያልፍበት ምድር ሆኑ።
text.en: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.

text.am: በባቢሎንም ውስጥ ቤልን እቀጣለሁ የዋጠውንም ከአፉ አስተፋዋለሁ፤ አሕዛብም ከዚያ ወዲያ ወደ እርሱ አይሰበሰቡም፥ የባቢሎንም ቅጥር ይወድቃል።
text.en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

text.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ከመካከልዋ ውጡ እያንዳንዳችሁም ከእግዚአብሔር ጽኑ ቍጣ ራሳችሁን አድኑ።
text.en: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.

text.am: በምድርም ከሚሰማ ወሬ የተነሣ አትፍሩ ልባችሁም የዛለ አይሁን፤ በአንድ ዓመት ወሬ ይመጣል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ በሌላው ዓመት ወሬ፥ በምድርም ላይ ግፍ ይመጣል፥ አለቃም በአለቃ ላይ ይነሣል።
text.en: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

text.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የተቀረጹትን የባቢሎን ምስሎች የምቀጣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ምድርዋም ሁሉ ታፍራለች፤ ተወግተውም የሞቱት ሁሉ በመካከልዋ ይወድቃሉ።
text.en: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

text.am: አጥፊዎች ከሰሜን ይመጡባታልና ሰማይና ምድር በእነርሱም ያለው ሁሉ ስለ ባቢሎን እልል ይላሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.

text.am: ባቢሎንም ከእስራኤል ተወግተው የሞቱት እንዲወድቁ እንዳደረገች፥ እንዲሁ በባቢሎን ከምድሩ ሁሉ ተወግተው የሞቱት ይወድቃሉ።
text.en: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

text.am: ከሰይፍ ያመለጣችሁ ሆይ፥ ሂዱ፥ አትቁሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርን ከሩቅ አስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም በልባችሁ አስቡ።
text.en: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

text.am: ስድብን ስለ ሰማን አፍረናል፤ ባዕዳን ሰዎችም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ገብተዋልና ነውር ፊታችንን ከድኖታል።
text.en: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD'S house.

text.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የተቀረጹትን ምስሎችዋ የምቀጣበት ዘመን ይመጣል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር በምድርዋም ላይ ሁሉ የተወጉት ያንቋርራሉ።
text.en: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

text.am: ባቢሎን ምንም ወደ ሰማይ ብትወጣ፥ የኃይልዋንም ከፍታ ብታጸና፥ ከእኔ ዘንድ አጥፊዎች ይመጡባታል፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.

text.am: ከባቢሎን ጩኸት፥ ከከለዳውያንም ምድር የታላቅ ጥፋት ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።
text.en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ባቢሎንን አጥፍቶአታልና፥ ከእርስዋም ታላቁን ድምፅ ዝም አሰኝቶአልና፤ ሞገዳቸውም እንደ ብዙ ውኆች ይተምማል፥ የድምፃቸውም ጩኸት ተሰምቶአል።
text.en: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:

text.am: አጥፊው በባቢሎን ላይ መጥቶባታልና፥ ኃያላኖችዋ ተያዙ፥ ቀስታቸውም ተሰባበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ፍዳን የሚከፍል አምላክ ነውና፥ ፍዳንም በእርግጥ ይከፍላል።
text.en: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.

text.am: መሳፍንቶችዋንና ጥበበኞችዋንም፥ አለቆችዋንና ሹማምቶችዋን ኃያላኖችዋንም አሰክራለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም አንቀላፍተው አይነቁም፥ ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተባለው ንጉሥ።
text.en: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.

text.am: የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰፊው የባቢሎን ቅጥር ፈጽሞ ይፈርሳል ረጃጅሞችም በሮችዋ በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ፤ የወገኖችም ድካም ከንቱ ትሆናለች፥ የአሕዛብም ሥራ ለእሳት ትሆናለች፤ እነርሱም ይደክማሉ።
text.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.

text.am: የመሕሤያ ልጅ የኔርያ ልጅ ሠራያ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሴዴቅያስ በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ባቢሎን በሄደ ጊዜ ነቢዩ ኤርምያስ ያዘዘው ቃል ይህ ነው። ሠራያም የቤት አዛዥ ነበረ።
text.en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.

text.am: በባቢሎንም ላይ የሚመጣውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ፥ ስለ ባቢሎን የተጻፈውን ይህን ቃል ሁሉ፥ ኤርምያስ በመጽሐፍ ላይ ጻፈው።
text.en: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.

text.am: ኤርምያስም ሠራያን እንዲህ አለው። ወደ ባቢሎን በገባህ ጊዜ እይ ይህንም ቃል ሁሉ አንብብና።
text.en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;

text.am: አቤቱ፥ ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ ማንም እንዳይቀመጥባት፥ ለዘላለምም ባድማ እንድትሆን ታጠፋት ዘንድ በዚህች ስፍራ ላይ ተናግረሃል በል።
text.en: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

text.am: ይህንም መጽሐፍ ማንበብ ከፈጸምህ በኋላ፥ ድንጋይን እሰርበት በኤፍራጥስም ውስጥ ጣለው፤
text.en: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

text.am: አንተም። እኔ ከማመጣባት ክፉ ነገር የተነሣ እንዲሁ ባቢሎን ትሰጥማለች አትነሣምም በል። የኤርምያስ ቃል እስከዚህ ድረስ ነው።
text.en: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

text.am: ሴዴቅያስ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አንድ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም አሚጣል የተባለች የሊብና ሰው የኤርምያስ ልጅ ነበረች።
text.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

text.am: ኢዮአቄምም እንዳደረገ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።
text.en: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

text.am: ከፊቱም አውጥቶ እስኪጥላቸው ድረስ ይህ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በኢየሩሳሌምና በይሁዳ ላይ ሆኖአልና፤ ሴዴቅያስም በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ላይ ዐመፀ።
text.en: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

text.am: ሴዴቅያስም በነገሠ በዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአሥረኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረኛው ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆርና ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ መጥተው ከበቡአት በዙሪያዋም ዕርድ አደረገ።
text.en: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.

text.am: ከተማይቱም እስከ ንጉሡ እስከ ሴዴቅያስ እስከ አሥራ አንደኛው ዓመት ድረስ ተከብባ ነበር።
text.en: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

text.am: በአራተኛውም ወር በዘጠነኛው ቀን በከተማይቱ ራብ ጸንቶ ነበር፥ ለአገሩም ሰዎች እንጀራ ታጣ።
text.en: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

text.am: ከተማይቱም ተሰበረች፥ ሰልፈኞችም ሁሉ ሸሹ፥ በሁለቱም ቅጥር መካከል ባለው በር ወደ ንጉሡ አትክልት በሚወስደው መንገድ በሌሊት ከከተማይቱ ወጡ። ከለዳውያንም በከተማይቱ ዙሪያ ነበሩ፤ በዓረባም መንገድ ሄዱ።
text.en: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

text.am: የከለዳውያንም ሠራዊት ንጉሡን ተከታተሉት፥ በኢያሪኮም ሜዳ ሴዴቅያስን ያዙ፤ ሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተበትነው ነበር።
text.en: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

text.am: ንጉሡንም ይዘው የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለባት በሐማት ምድር ወዳለችው ወደ ሪብላ አመጡት፤ እርሱም ፍርድን በእርሱ ላይ ተናገረ።
text.en: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

text.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ የሴዴቅያስን ልጆች በፊቱ ገደላቸው፥ የይሁዳንም አለቆች ሁሉ ደግሞ በሪብላ ገደላቸው።
text.en: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

text.am: የሴዴቅያስንም ዓይኖች አወጣ፤ የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሰንሰለት አሰረው ወደ ባቢሎንም ወሰደው፥ እስኪሞትም ድረስ በግዞት ቤት አኖረው።
text.en: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

text.am: በባቢሎን ንጉሥ በናቡከደነፆር በአሥራ ዘጠነኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥረናው ከን በባቢሎን ንጉሥ ፊት የቆመው የዘበኞቹ አለካ ናቡዘረዳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።
text.en: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት አቃጠለ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ ታላላቆችን ቤቶች ሁሉ፥ በእሳት አቃጠለ።
text.en: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:

text.am: ከዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጋር የነበረው የከለዳውያን ሠራዊት ሁሉ የኢየሩሳሌምን ቅጥር ሁሉ ዙሪያዋን አፈረሱ።
text.en: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

text.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን የሕዝቡን ድኆች፥ በከተማም ውስጥ የቀረውን ሕዝብ፥ ሸሽተውም ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ የተጠጉትን፥ የሕዝቡንም ቅሬታ አፈለሰ።
text.en: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

text.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአገሩ ድኆች ወይን ተካዮችና አራሾች እንዲሆኑ አስቀረ።
text.en: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

text.am: ከለዳውያንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበሩትን የናስ ዓምዶች በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የነበሩትን መቀመጫዎችና የናሱን ኵሬ ሰባበሩ፥ ናሱንም ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዱ።
text.en: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

text.am: ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎችንም መኰስተሪያዎችንና ድስቶችን ጭልፋዎችንም የሚያገለግሉበትንም የናስ ዕቃ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።
text.en: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

text.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ጽዋዎቹንና ማንደጃዎቹን ድስቶቹንና ምንቸቶችን መቅረዞችንና ጭልፋዎቹን መንቀሎችንም፥ የወርቁን ዕቃ በወርቅ፥ የብሩንም ዕቃ በብር አድርጎ፥ ወሰደ።
text.en: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.

text.am: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያሠራቸውን ሁለቱን ዓምዶች፥ አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ ከመቀመጫዎቹም በታች የነበሩትን አሥራ ሁለቱን የናስ በሬዎች ወሰደ፤ ለእነዚህ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ናስ ሚዛን አልነበረም።
text.en: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

text.am: ዓምዶቹም፥ የአንዱ ዓምድ ቁመት አሥራ ስምንት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የዙሪያውም መጠን አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፤ ውፍረቱም አራት ጣት ያህል ነበረ፥ ባዶም ነበረ።
text.en: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

text.am: የናሱም ጕልላት በላዩ ነበረ፤ የአንዱም ጉልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ በጕልላቱም ላይ በዙሪያው ሁሉ ከናስ የተሠሩ መረበብና ሮማኖች ነበሩበት፤ በሁለተኛውም ዓምድ ደግሞ እንደዚህ ያለ ነገርና ሮማኖች ነበሩበት።
text.en: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.

text.am: በስተ ውጭም ዘጠና ስድስት ሮማኖች ነበሩ። በመረበቡም ዙሪያ የነበሩ ሮማኖች ሁሉ አንድ መቶ ነበሩ።
text.en: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.

text.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ታላቁን ካህን ሠራያን ሁለተኛውንም ካህን ሶፎንያስን ሦስቱንም በረኞች ወሰደ፤
text.en: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

text.am: ከከተማይቱም በሰልፈኞች ላይ ተሾመው ከነበሩት አንዱን ጀንደረባ፥ በከተማይቱም ከሚገኙት በንጉሡ ፊት ከሚቆሙት ሰባቱን ሰዎች፥ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ የሚያሰልፈውን የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ጸሐፊ፥ በከተማይቱም ከተገኙት ከአገሩ ሕዝብ ስድሳ ሰዎች ወሰደ።
text.en: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

text.am: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወስዶ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወዳለበት ወደ ሪብላ አመጣቸው።
text.en: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

text.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ መታቸው፥ በሐማትም ምድር ባለችው በሪብላ ገደላቸው። እንዲሁ ይሁዳ ከአገሩ ተማረከ።
text.en: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

text.am: ናቡከደነፆር የማረከው ሕዝብ ይህ ነው፤ በሰባተኛው ዓመት ሦስት ሺህ ሀያ ሦስት አይሁድ፤
text.en: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

text.am: ናቡከደነፆርም በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ስምንት መቶ ሠላሳ ሁለት ነፍስ ከኢየሩሳሌም ማርኮአል፤
text.en: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

text.am: በናቡከደነፆር በሀያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአይሁድ ሰባት መቶ አርባ አምስት ነፍስ ማርኮአል፤ ሰዎች ሁሉ አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።
text.en: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

text.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪን በተማረከ በሠላሳ ሰባተኛው ዓመት በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በሀያ አምስተኛው ቀን፥ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ዮርማሮዴክ በነገሠ በአንደኛው ዓመት የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የዮአኪንን ራስ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ ከወህኒም አወጣው፤
text.en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,

text.am: በመልካምም ተናገረው፥ ዙፋኑንም ከእርሱ ጋር በባቢሎን ከነበሩት ነገሥታት ዙፋን በላይ አደረገለት።
text.en: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

text.am: በወህኒም ውስጥ ለብሶት የነበረውን ልብስ ለወጠለት፥ ዮአኪንም በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ በፊቴ ሁልጊዜ እንጀራ ይበላ ነበር።
text.en: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

text.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ እስኪሞት ድረስ የዘወትር ቀለብ ዕለት ዕለት ይሰጠው ነበር።
text.en: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
